# Array

*JavaScript*

Methods of JavaScript arrays. Callbacks get `(element, index, array)`. Methods marked as changing the array modify it in place; the others return a new value.

## Methods

### at {#at}

::: member

Returns the element at an index; negative indexes count from the end.

```js
[1, 2, 3].at(-1); // 3
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | position, negative from the end |

**Returns** `any` — the element, or `undefined` if the index is out of range

:::

### concat {#concat}

::: member

Joins arrays or values into a new array.

```js
[1, 2].concat([3], 4); // [1, 2, 3, 4]
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | `any` | arrays or values to append |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — the new array

:::

### copyWithin {#copywithin}

::: member

Changes the array: copies a part of it to another position.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index to copy to |
| `start` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | first index to copy |
| `end` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index after the last one to copy; optional, the end by default |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — this array

:::

### entries {#entries}

::: member

Iterates `[index, element]` pairs.

```js
for (const [i, item] of list.entries()) { ... }
```

**Returns** `Iterator` — iterator of pairs

:::

### every {#every}

::: member

Checks whether all elements pass a test.

```js
[2, 4].every(function (n) { return n % 2 === 0; }); // true
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `Function` | test `(element, index, array) => boolean` |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — `true` if the callback returned true for every element

:::

### fill {#fill}

::: member

Changes the array: sets elements to a value.

```js
new Array(3).fill(0); // [0, 0, 0]
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `any` | value to set |
| `start` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | first index; optional, 0 by default |
| `end` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index after the last one; optional, the end by default |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — this array

:::

### filter {#filter}

::: member

Keeps the elements that pass a test.

```js
players.filter(function (p) { return p.getHp() < 5; });
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `Function` | test `(element, index, array) => boolean` |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — new array with the passed elements

:::

### find {#find}

::: member

Finds the first element that passes a test.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `Function` | test `(element, index, array) => boolean` |

**Returns** `any` — the element, or `undefined` if none passes

:::

### findIndex {#findindex}

::: member

Finds the index of the first element that passes a test.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `Function` | test `(element, index, array) => boolean` |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the index, or `-1` if none passes

:::

### findLast {#findlast}

::: member

Finds the last element that passes a test.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `Function` | test `(element, index, array) => boolean` |

**Returns** `any` — the element, or `undefined` if none passes

:::

### findLastIndex {#findlastindex}

::: member

Finds the index of the last element that passes a test.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `Function` | test `(element, index, array) => boolean` |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the index, or `-1` if none passes

:::

### flat {#flat}

::: member

Flattens nested arrays.

```js
[1, [2, [3]]].flat(); // [1, 2, [3]]
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `depth` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | how many levels to flatten; optional, 1 by default |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — the new flat array

:::

### flatMap {#flatmap}

::: member

Maps each element to an array and joins the results one level deep.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `Function` | mapper `(element, index, array) => value or array` |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — the new array

:::

### forEach {#foreach}

::: member

Calls a function for every element.

```js
players.forEach(function (p) { p.send('Hi'); });
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `Function` | action `(element, index, array)` |

:::

### includes {#includes}

::: member

Checks whether the array contains a value.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `any` | value to look for |
| `fromIndex` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index to start from; optional, 0 by default |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — `true` if the value is found

:::

### indexOf {#indexof}

::: member

Finds the first index of a value.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `any` | value to look for |
| `fromIndex` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index to start from; optional, 0 by default |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the index, or `-1` if not found

:::

### join {#join}

::: member

Joins the elements into a string.

```js
['a', 'b'].join(', '); // 'a, b'
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `separator` | [`string`](/scripting/js/String) | text between elements; optional, a comma by default |

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the joined string

:::

### keys {#keys}

::: member

Iterates the indexes.

**Returns** `Iterator` — iterator of indexes

:::

### lastIndexOf {#lastindexof}

::: member

Finds the last index of a value.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `any` | value to look for |
| `fromIndex` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index to search backwards from; optional, the end by default |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the index, or `-1` if not found

:::

### map {#map}

::: member

Converts every element.

```js
[1, 2, 3].map(function (n) { return n * 2; }); // [2, 4, 6]
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `Function` | mapper `(element, index, array) => value` |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — new array of the results

:::

### pop {#pop}

::: member

Changes the array: removes the last element.

**Returns** `any` — the removed element, or `undefined` if the array is empty

:::

### push {#push}

::: member

Changes the array: adds elements to the end.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `elements` | `any` | one or more elements to add |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the new length

:::

### reduce {#reduce}

::: member

Combines all elements into one value, from the first to the last.

```js
[1, 2, 3].reduce(function (sum, n) { return sum + n; }, 0); // 6
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `Function` | reducer `(accumulator, element, index, array) => accumulator` |
| `initialValue` | `any` | start value; optional, the first element by default (an error for an empty array) |

**Returns** `any` — the combined value

:::

### reduceRight {#reduceright}

::: member

Like `reduce`, from the last element to the first.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `Function` | reducer `(accumulator, element, index, array) => accumulator` |
| `initialValue` | `any` | start value; optional |

**Returns** `any` — the combined value

:::

### reverse {#reverse}

::: member

Changes the array: reverses the order of elements. `toReversed` keeps the array.

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — this array

:::

### shift {#shift}

::: member

Changes the array: removes the first element.

**Returns** `any` — the removed element, or `undefined` if the array is empty

:::

### slice {#slice}

::: member

Copies a part of the array; negative indexes count from the end.

```js
[1, 2, 3, 4].slice(1, 3); // [2, 3]
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | first index; optional, 0 by default |
| `end` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index after the last one; optional, the end by default |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — the new array

:::

### some {#some}

::: member

Checks whether at least one element passes a test.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` | `Function` | test `(element, index, array) => boolean` |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — `true` if the callback returned true for any element

:::

### sort {#sort}

::: member

Changes the array: sorts it. Without a function, elements are compared as strings, so numbers need one.

```js
scores.sort(function (a, b) { return b - a; }); // descending
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `compare` | `Function` | `(a, b) => number`: negative if `a` goes first; optional |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — this array

:::

### splice {#splice}

::: member

Changes the array: removes elements and inserts new ones at an index.

```js
list.splice(1, 2); // removes 2 elements from index 1
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index to change at |
| `deleteCount` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | how many to remove; optional, all to the end by default |
| `items` | `any` | elements to insert; optional |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — the removed elements

:::

### toLocaleString {#tolocalestring}

::: member

Joins the elements as strings formatted for the language.

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the joined string

:::

### toReversed {#toreversed}

::: member

Returns a reversed copy; the array is not changed.

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — the reversed copy

:::

### toSorted {#tosorted}

::: member

Returns a sorted copy; the array is not changed.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `compare` | `Function` | `(a, b) => number`; optional |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — the sorted copy

:::

### toSpliced {#tospliced}

::: member

Like `splice`, but returns a changed copy and keeps the array.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index to change at |
| `deleteCount` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | how many to remove; optional |
| `items` | `any` | elements to insert; optional |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — the changed copy

:::

### toString {#tostring}

::: member

Joins the elements with commas.

**Returns** [`string`](/scripting/js/String) — the joined string

:::

### unshift {#unshift}

::: member

Changes the array: adds elements to the start.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `elements` | `any` | one or more elements to add |

**Returns** [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) — the new length

:::

### values {#values}

::: member

Iterates the elements.

**Returns** `Iterator` — iterator of elements

:::

### with {#with}

::: member

Returns a copy with one element replaced; the array is not changed.

```js
[1, 2, 3].with(0, 9); // [9, 2, 3]
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | [`number`](/scripting/js/Number) | index to replace, negative from the end |
| `value` | `any` | new element |

**Returns** [`Array`](/scripting/js/Array) — the changed copy

:::
